data.name: Carroll
data.gender_notes: Carroll is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Wearing a freckled or speckled garment
data.long_meaning: The Old English name Carroll is derived from the Anglo-Saxon words 'carr' meaning 'deer' and 'hol' meaning 'valley' or 'clearing'. This name was given to individuals who lived in a deer-filled clearing. In some instances, it may be associated with the freckled or speckled clothing worn by certain monastic orders. The name Carroll carries the meaning “Wearing a freckled or speckled garment” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carroll usually hope their child will grow to embody wearing a freckled or speckled garment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
